scope: CVG-003 bounded ABAC enforcement for GET /audit/events

criteria.description: A fresh independent scout confirmed that GET /audit/events uses RBAC audit.read but bypasses the existing enforceAbac callback, while abac-006 already governs audit_entry/audit.read.
criteria.limitations: The finding is limited to GET /audit/events and does not claim that other audit or sensitive surfaces share the same gap.

criteria.description: The authorized correction is limited to passing the existing server enforceAbac callback into AccessControlRoutesHandlers, invoking audit.read before the GET /audit/events audit read, and documenting its existing Bearer/401/403 contract.
criteria.limitations: No operational-coverage source-of-truth change, reprocess/replay change, policy broadening, systemic ABAC, storage, worker or external change is authorized.

criteria.description: Focused RED tests must fail before implementation for missing ABAC invocation and fail-closed denial, while GREEN must preserve audit filters, cursor pagination, account binding, audit append and response behavior.
criteria.limitations: The gate authorizes implementation and verification only; it is not evidence of GREEN, quality, global parity or release readiness.

gaps: GET /audit/operational-coverage has a separate source-of-truth/cache semantics gap and is deferred.
Reprocess/audit.write and replay-after-revocation authorization remain separate P0 follow-ups.
Systemic ABAC, other audit/log/trace/export surfaces, global parity, target operations and release evidence remain open.
conditions: Implement only GET /audit/events callback wiring, focused tests and matching OpenAPI security/error documentation.
Use resourceType audit_entry, resourceId events and the authenticated principal account.
Preserve the existing audit service, account scope, filters, cursor, limit, append-audit behavior and response shape.
Keep /audit/operational-coverage, reprocess/replay, systemic ABAC and all provider/target/production/deployment/release work outside this gate.
Keep CVG-003/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation of the consolidation request and fresh bounded scout selection
authority.scope: CVG-003 bounded ABAC enforcement for GET /audit/events only
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository-local route, server seam, focused test and OpenAPI documentation changes for the existing audit.read ABAC policy. Exclude operational-coverage source-of-truth changes, reprocess/audit.write, replay-after-revocation, systemic ABAC, policy broadening, storage, workers, migrations, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before enforcing ABAC on operational coverage or another audit family, changing policy definitions, adding replay controls or expanding beyond GET /audit/events.

next_action: Write and execute intentional RED assertions for ABAC invocation and fail-closed denial before the GET /audit/events audit read, then implement the smallest callback seam.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to abac-006 or policy semantics
Reprocess/replay authorization or permission revocation handling
Expansion to migrations, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment or release scope
